result.summary: Found 2 major issues: the bottom restaurant card is visually truncated by the bottom navigation, and the promotional banner has poor text contrast.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, hiding the restaurant name, delivery time, rating, and cuisine info.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content container so the last item is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses light/white text on a light mint-green background, resulting in insufficient color contrast that makes the offer details hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text (e.g., dark green or black) or a darker background color in the banner to meet minimum contrast requirements.
